items.title: Lee Simpson (founder of Jefferson City Buzzards) Interview, 1948-06-09

ctx.x: We are gathered here at the clubhouse of the Jefferson City Partners Carnival Club. Mr. Simpson, as much as you are the last surviving member of the original group who founded the Jefferson City Partners, we younger members of the club have come to you for some really authentic first-hand information, and we feel certain that you will give it to us for the best of your ability. We are prompted to do this because we believe that the fighters will continue as the granddaddy of the marching clubs around New Orleans…
Thank you. Marley's case, Elliman. And here is Mr. Simpson. You want Mr. Toto? I asked him to correct you so I can answer.
